class.name: CgameHDROutput
class.brief_description: Enables HDR display output by quality level.
class.description: [CgameHDROutput] decides whether the main window should output HDR10 / EDR and drives the [DisplayServer] HDR API accordingly. HDR is wanted only when the display supports it, the renderer is not [code]gl_compatibility[/code], and the quality level is [code]2[/code] (High) or [code]3[/code] (Ultra). SDR screens and lower presets keep the 8-bit path. When HDR is enabled the reference (paper white) luminance is set to 200 nits so UI and diffuse surfaces stay comfortable while highlights such as sun, fire and lightning use the headroom.

method.name: apply
method.description: Requests HDR output on the main window when [method wanted] allows it for the current display, and disables it otherwise. Returns [code]true[/code] when HDR output was requested.

method.name: supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the main window's display reports HDR support. Always [code]false[/code] on the headless display server.

method.name: wanted
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when HDR output should be used: [param supported] is [code]true[/code], [param rendering_method] is not [code]gl_compatibility[/code] and [param level] (clamped to [code]0..3[/code]) is at least [code]2[/code].
